instruction: A candid street photograph with a full-body shot of two women embracing on a city sidewalk next to a green subway railing. On the left, the woman in the beige coat and white pants (R1) stands with her back partially to the camera, wrapping her arms around her friend. On the right, the woman with curly hair and a brown coat (R2) faces left, smiling warmly as she returns the hug, a black handbag hanging from her arm. The scene is captured in natural daylight with soft shadows and a muted urban color palette.
